meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill. Self-orchestrates 5 hostile category members (unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via team-mode for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the defensible insights, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled insight bundle to the `plan` agent for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用多智能体对抗辩论提炼规划洞察，生成可执行方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在规划时暴露弱假设并避免盲点
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to surface weak assumptions and blind spots in your planning process

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 成为 5 人敌对规划团队的 Lead：成员之间互相挑刺，只保留经得住攻击的洞见，再强制交给 plan agent 形式化为可执行计划。
howto.when: 当规划需要最大严格度、要暴露薄弱假设与过度设计时触发；提到 “hyperplan”、“hpp”、“/hyperplan” 等词即可。需 team-mode 工具可用，且在主会话以 lead 角色运行。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 规划这次数据库迁移，尽量暴露薄弱假设
hyperplan：帮我评审这个重构方案有没有过度设计
say.note: 简化派成员会攻击过度设计与超前抽象

say.text: /hyperplan 规划新支付流程的落地方案
say.note: 存活洞见会交给 plan agent 生成可执行计划

howto.what_en: Claude becomes Lead of a 5-member hostile planning team: members cross-critique each other, only defensible insights survive, then the bundle is handed to the plan agent to formalize an executable plan.
howto.when_en: For planning that needs maximum rigor and to surface weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', etc. Needs team-mode tools in a top-level lead session.

say_en.text: Hyperplan this database migration and surface the weak assumptions.
say_en.note: Prints HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED! and spawns 5 hostile members.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to review this refactor for over-engineering.
say_en.note: The simplicity skeptic attacks scope creep.

say_en.text: /hyperplan plan the rollout for the new payment flow.
say_en.note: Surviving insights go to the plan agent.
